slides.headline: EVERY EXPERT SAID AGI WAS STILL YEARS AWAY
slides.body: That was the deal. The goalpost had been moved for 70 years, always just out of reach. Then Jensen Huang posted a tweet.

slides.headline: JENSEN HUANG TYPED THREE WORDS WITH NO STAGE, NO DEMO, NO BENCHMARK
slides.body:
He didn't call a press conference. No announcement stage, no demo, no benchmark.

The CEO who built the machine that powered the entire AI race posted it casually online.

tweet.text: BREAKING: Nvidia, $NVDA, CEO Jensen Huang says Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) has arrived.

caption:
Swipe through this. Jensen Huang just declared human-level AI is here, and the man saying it supplies every chip that runs AI on Earth. 🤖

Cover: Jensen Huang declares AGI has arrived, Slide 2: why the whole world assumed it was still years away, Slide 3: the moment he posted it and why it lands differently coming from him, Slide 4: exactly what he wrote, Slide 5: the catch, Slide 6: who stands to gain most from this statement, Slide 7: save this for the conversation you're about to have.

For 70 years, AGI was a moving goalpost. The CEO of the company powering the entire AI race just said it's been crossed. Whether he's right or making the most lucrative statement in tech history, the conversation about AI and your future just stopped being theoretical.

Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this means for yours.

Sources: The Kobeissi Letter on X, Jensen Huang on X

#AI #AGI #Nvidia #JensenHuang #ArtificialIntelligence

specifics: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said AGI — human-level AI — has officially arrived
Huang runs the company that makes the chips every major AI system runs on
The declaration was made September 6, 2026 and hit 500.8K views immediately
No evidence, demo, or benchmark was cited — just the statement itself
This is the first time a major tech CEO has flatly declared AGI is here, not coming
